notes: The outcome and responsibility predictor match, but p.3 contains both sole-predictor and covariate-adjusted multilevel models plus a meta-analysis of country regressions. The supplied description does not identify the model, adjustment set, or aggregation. No candidate is selected. Printed candidates: Table 1 Model 1b B = 0.09, SE = 0.002; Model 2b B = 0.08, SE = 0.002; all responsibility coefficients have *** denoting p < .001 (bound l, threshold .001). Section 3.2 country-regression meta-analysis: B = 0.08, SE = 0.004, z = 18.31, p < .001, 95% C.I. = [0.07, 0.09], I2 = 85.77%. Printed metric is B (table header B (S.E.)); no conversion or inferred standardization was applied. Within-country regressions/forest estimates are additional distinct tests, not selected. Candidate sample N = 40,117 is explicitly the analyzed replication sample, but Table 1 gives no per-model N; it is not promoted to a target-test analytic N. No group sum or df-derived N.
